BAI opens accreditation window for foreign pork establishments

Posted August 28, 2026. The Bureau of Animal Industry announced that foreign meat establishments, including those in the Russian Federation, may submit applications for accreditation to export pork and poultry products to the Philippines. Applications are processed under Memorandum Order series 2026. Importers must secure a Veterinary Quarantine Clearance before shipment.

BAI maintains temporary ban on beef from selected zones

Posted August 30, 2026. The temporary ban follows a foot and mouth disease report. Beef and offal consignments from affected zones will not be issued import clearances until further notice.

Notice: BAI regional office holiday schedule

Posted August 25, 2026. Happy holidays to all personnel. Offices will be closed.
